name: AI Addendum
description: Addendum to a commercial agreement governing a provider's AI services, including use of customer input, generated output, and model training restrictions.

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: HIPAA Business Associate Agreement setting out how a provider may use, disclose, and safeguard protected health information (PHI).

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: Standard terms for selling and buying cloud software (SaaS), covering access and use, support, fees, confidentiality, warranties, and liability.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: Agreement governing the processing of personal data by a provider on behalf of a customer, addressing GDPR and other data protection laws.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: Agreement giving an early-stage partner access to a product in exchange for feedback and participation in a design partner program.

name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement - Cover Page
description: Cover page for the Mutual NDA where the parties fill in the purpose, effective date, term, governing law, and signatures.

name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement - Standard Terms
description: Standard terms for a mutual NDA allowing both parties to share and protect confidential information for an agreed purpose.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: Agreement for business partnerships between two companies, covering each party's obligations, feedback, trademark use, payments, and liability.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: Short-term agreement allowing a prospective customer to trial or evaluate a product before committing to a full commercial agreement.

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: Standard terms for professional services delivered under statements of work (SOWs), covering deliverables, fees, IP ownership, and liability.

name: Service Level Agreement
description: Service level commitments for a cloud service, including target uptime, response times, and service credits for missed targets.

name: Software License Agreement
description: Standard terms for licensing installable (on-premise) software, covering license grant, support, fees, warranties, and liability.
